description: This file implements the MonitorJsonRpc class, providing RPC endpoints for managing plugin restart limits, resetting plugin statistics, retrieving plugin status, and signaling monitor actions within the WPEFramework plugin system.

classes.name: Monitor
classes.description: A class providing JSON-RPC endpoints for plugin monitoring, including restart limits, statistics reset, status retrieval, and event signaling.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers RPC endpoints and properties for the monitor.

methods.name: UnregisterAll
methods.description: Unregisters RPC endpoints and properties for the monitor.

methods.name: endpoint_restartlimits
methods.description: Sets new restart limits for a plugin identified by callsign.

methods.name: endpoint_resetstats
methods.description: Resets memory and process statistics for a specified plugin.

methods.name: get_status
methods.description: Retrieves the current status (memory and process statistics) for a plugin or all plugins.

methods.name: event_action
methods.description: Signals an action taken by the monitor for a specific plugin.
